newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portucel shares rise on pulp price news.
newsitem.headline: Portucel shares rise on pulp price news.

text.p: Shares in Portucel Industrial -Empresa Produtora de Celulose rose slightly on news the pulp group would raise its white eucalyptus price, but dealers doubted the share would exceed the day's high of 1,055 escudos.
"The positive reaction was automatic and the share rose immediately to 1,055 escudos, but it shouldn't break through that level," said one operator.
Another said: "An increase in the pulp price was already expected, considering the decisions of Nordic producers to raise prices."
Portucel shares stood at 1,047 escudos, up five, in volume of 43,053 shares at 1019 GMT.
Earlier, Portucel said it would raise the price of white eucalyptus pulp by 30 Ecus per tonne to 450 Ecus per tonne effective from October 1.
